The '''Tashtor Seneca system''' was a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Tashtor sector/Legends|Tashtor sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was connected to the [[Chalcedon system/Legends|Chalcedon system]] and the [[Petabys Station]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Tashtor Seneca [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the location known as [[Tashtor Seneca]], over which the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] destroyed the ''[[Croc of Gold]]'', the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[operative]] [[Devon Fuller]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tashtor Seneca system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-16.<ref name="TEA" />
